stage0002_03:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text: $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, Captain's Cabin

stage0002_03:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text: $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, Captain's Cabin

stage0002_03:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text: $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, Captain's Cabin

stage0002_03:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text: ～ Submarine $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, Captain's Cabin ～

stage0002_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Judging by that look on your face,
　the news is not especially good.」

stage0002_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes...
　From what $$ウルズ$$ 2 observed on site,
　that Unknown...」

stage0002_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$テッサ$$
「It does appear to be built with technology
　outside any system we know of.」

stage0002_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Visitors from another world, or another star...」

stage0002_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「And ones carrying some manner of hostility...」

stage0002_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$テッサ$$
「It means the fears of our superiors
　have grown more likely to come true.」

stage0002_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「So that is why $$ミスリル$$ changed its policy...」

stage0002_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$テッサ$$
「...Assuming the worst before the facts are clear
　will only be demoralising.」

stage0002_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$テッサ$$
「We'll leave the judgment to the higher-ups
　and clear the danger in front of us first.」

stage0002_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「On that matter, as of yesterday,
　the mission in question has moved to Plan B.」

stage0002_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Direct guard duty on the subject...
　Can he manage that?」

stage0002_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Of all the 《$$ＳＲＴ$$》 members, he is the only one
　suited to an undercover posting in Japan.」

stage0002_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$テッサ$$
「So Sergeant Sagara was chosen by elimination?」

stage0002_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「I won't deny it.
　But he will get it done, without fail.」

stage0002_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$テッサ$$
「For now, all I can do is believe that.」

stage0002_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Captain, Major $$オズマ・リー$$ of 《$$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$》
　and Lieutenant $$カナリア・ベルシュタイン$$
　have arrived aboard.」

stage0002_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Understood.
　Then I'll go down to the hangar to meet them...」

stage0002_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I-I'm fine...
　I only tripped and fell, that's all...」

stage0002_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Then I shall call the maintenance crew
　and have that protruding cable guard
　sunk into the deck.」

stage0002_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$カリーニン$$
（The Sergeant's new mission must be starting now...）

stage0002_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$恭子$$
「Kana, did you see the morning news?」

stage0002_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I've been glued to the TV since last night.
　They showed Jindai High too.」

stage0002_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$恭子$$
「A $$時空震動$$, and mysterious robots fighting...
　They say nobody knows what that bat-thing
　or the blue robot even are...」

stage0002_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Still, the Earth Federation Forces were useless.
　No point rushing in after it's all over.」

stage0002_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$恭子$$
「The commentator on the night news was angry too.
　Disarmament matters, but being no use at a time
　like this? Come on...」

stage0002_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$恭子$$
「That's a bit contradictory, isn't it...」

stage0002_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$かなめ$$
「It's an unfair thing to ask, but I get it.
　Everyone wants things peaceful at least
　around themselves, after all.」

stage0002_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$恭子$$
「Speaking of peace...
　Kana, you remember today's bag check, right?」

stage0002_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Of course!
　I left anything risky at home.」

stage0002_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Well... by risky I mean
　playing cards, snacks, a handheld game.」

stage0002_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$恭子$$
「Ah... look!
　Miss Kagurazaka's caught somebody at the gate!」

stage0002_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$恵理$$
「...On your very first day...!
　Toy guns like this are confiscated!」

stage0002_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$宗介$$
「No, that is not a toy...」

stage0002_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$宗介$$
「This Glock 26 is loaded with high-lethality
　Scrat rounds.」

stage0002_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$宗介$$
「It is extremely dangerous.
　Do not touch the trigger under any circumstances.
　An accidental discharge will kill someone.」

stage0002_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$恵理$$
「Yes, yes.
　I understand, so settle down.」

stage0002_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Ugh, he's one of those nuts.
　Bringing a model gun all the way to school?
　Sooo creepy...!」

stage0002_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$恭子$$
「If he didn't know about today's bag check,
　he must be a transfer student.」

stage0002_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$恭子$$
「Y-you scared me!
　$l, when did you get here?」

stage0002_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Do you know that military nut?」

stage0002_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Should the three of you be taking it easy?
　Morning homeroom is about to start.」

stage0002_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Thank you for yesterday.
　If you hadn't been there, we'd have...」

stage0002_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I may only be a student teacher, but I'm still
　a teacher. Protecting you all is my duty.」

stage0002_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$スズネ$$
「And that includes chasing my own students
　so they don't turn up late.」

stage0002_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$l, thank you for yesterday.
　You were the one who saved me, weren't you.」

stage0002_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$スズネ$$
「But...
　And about that blue robot...」

stage0002_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$n
「...It happened after school.
　You shouldn't stick your nose into it, Miss.」

stage0002_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$恵理$$
「All right, everyone, quiet down!
　I'm introducing a new classmate.」

stage0002_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$宗介$$
「Sergeant $$相良宗介$$!
　Place of origin, the 《$$ＡＤＷ$$》!」

stage0002_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「That's not it...!
　It's like Hashiba Chikuzen-no-Kami Hideyoshi!」

stage0002_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$恭子$$
「I don't think that's it either...」

stage0002_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$恵理$$
「Quiet!
　Come on, listen to the end!
　...And Sagara, stop fooling around!」

stage0002_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$宗介$$
「I am $$相良宗介$$.
　With respect, please forget the sergeant part.
　That is all!」

stage0002_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$詩織$$
「Sagara, where did you come from?」

stage0002_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$宗介$$
「Sir! Taribia, Ezemistan, Limonesia,
　the $$暗黒大陸$$, Sanc Kingdom, Shinjuku Ghetto...」

stage0002_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$恵理$$
「Y-y-you... spent a long time living abroad,
　didn't you...」

stage0002_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$宗介$$
「No, I was deployed not only inside
　the atmosphere but into space as well.」

stage0002_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$宗介$$
「Resource satellite MO-II, the L4 colonies,
　the Frontier fleet, planet $$クエント$$, the Barge...」

stage0002_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「I saw you at the gate.
　Model guns, right?」

stage0002_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$恭子$$
「What kind of books do you read?」

stage0002_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$宗介$$
「Mainly technical books and trade journals.
　I go through Jane's Yearbook regularly.」

stage0002_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$宗介$$
「Soldier of Fortune and the like are
　enjoyable enough, and I subscribe to Harris
　Publishing's Arm Slave Monthly.」

stage0002_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$宗介$$
「I have also read 'AS for Men Monthly'.」

stage0002_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$宗介$$
「Lately I am absorbed in tactical study of the
　post-《$$新世時空震動$$》 era, on the utility of GN
　Drives under Minovsky particle dispersal...」

stage0002_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$詩織$$
「Um... do you have a favorite musician?」

stage0002_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$宗介$$
「Uh... ugh... $$シェリル・ノーム$$, and...」

stage0002_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「What kind of taste is that!?」

stage0002_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$かなめ$$
「What's wrong, $l...?
　Is that transfer student bothering you?」

stage0002_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$n
「No... it's nothing...
　Don't worry about it.」

stage0002_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...Oh, I know!
　You're both new, why not get to know Sagara?」

stage0002_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Nice idea, if I do say so myself!
　That way I can show you both around
　the school and the town at once.」

stage0002_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$n
（...But first I have to find out who he is...）

stage0002_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$マオ$$
「Good work.
　We set up a report like this since it's day one,
　but from tomorrow just stay glued to the subject.」

stage0002_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$クルツ$$
「But hey, you sure about this?
　Taking your eyes off your little 'Angel'?」

stage0002_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$宗介$$
「No problem.
　I can watch the subject from here as well.」

stage0002_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$宗介$$
「More to the point, this spot is ideal cover
　for an enemy. It needs to be surveyed.」

stage0002_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Oh-ho... aren't you the dedicated one.」

stage0002_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$クルツ$$
「When I heard a 《$$ミスリル$$》 merc like you
　was infiltrating a high school I howled,
　but I guess helping you out was worth it.」

stage0002_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$クルツ$$
「You've lived on battlefields since you could think.
　You're basically missing any social sense.」

stage0002_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$クルツ$$
「So, how'd it go?
　That modern-high-schooler image I coached you on...
　pretty useful, wasn't it?」

stage0002_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$宗介$$
「About that, $$クルツ$$...
　To Japanese high school students, your taste
　in music is apparently abnormal.」

stage0002_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$クルツ$$
「The hell!? You got a problem
　with my beloved $$シェリル$$ and $$徳川喜一郎$$!?」

stage0002_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Damn it!
　I'll go meet whoever it is myself and give them
　an earful about how great those two are!」

stage0002_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$宗介$$
「Your scheme is transparent.
　You intend to use that to skip out on
　standby duty around the subject, don't you?」

stage0002_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Tch...! You saw right through me!
　In that case...」

stage0002_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$宗介$$
「...Wait.
　Someone is coming.
　Ending transmission here.」

stage0002_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$n
「...So you noticed me coming...
　You really aren't just a transfer student...」

stage0002_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$宗介$$
「That uniform... a Jindai High student.」

stage0002_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$n
「Don't play dumb.
　You hid it well, but I knew you had me
　marked.」

stage0002_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$宗介$$
（I remember now...
　This is the one seated next to $$千鳥かなめ$$.）

stage0002_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$宗介$$
（But he noticed my eyes on him, and he closed
　in this far without my sensing it. This man...）

stage0002_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$n
「...Are you one of those $$ＤＥＭ$$ people?
　Or could you be...」

stage0002_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$宗介$$
「...I don't know what you're talking about,
　but as long as there is a risk...」

stage0002_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$n
「Can you manage with your Glock confiscated?」

stage0002_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$n
「A blackjack...!
　You still had a weapon hidden...!」

stage0002_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$宗介$$
（This man, just as I thought...）

stage0002_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$宗介$$
「This is what became of your comrade.」

stage0002_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$n
「...You set assassins on me to take $$ジェニオン$$,
　and that's what you have to say?」

stage0002_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「THAT PERSON IS A MITHRIL MERCENARY.
　HE HAS NO CONNECTION TO OUR COMPANY.」

stage0002_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「NEVER MIND THAT, IT IS AN EMERGENCY!」

stage0002_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$宗介$$
「That is close to the school!」

stage0002_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$マオ$$
「Sergeant Major $$メリッサ・マオ$$, $$ミスリル$$ Operations,
　West Pacific Squadron, ground command 《$$ＳＲＴ$$》.」

stage0002_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Welcome aboard.
　I am Captain $$ジェフリー・ワイルダー$$,
　commander of the Macross Quarter.」

stage0002_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$マオ$$
「Your reputation precedes you.
　It's an honor to meet you, Captain Wilder.」

stage0002_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Such formality only embarrasses me, Sergeant Major.
　We'll be running operations together from now on,
　so do relax.」

stage0002_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Word of $$ミスリル$$'s work reaches me, unofficially.
　$$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ agreed with what you stand for, and that is
　why we now fight together.」

stage0002_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Um... Captain $$ジェフリー$$,
　what exactly is this $$ミスリル$$?」

stage0002_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「In a word, they are a secret counter-terror
　mercenary force for peacekeeping by force of arms.」

stage0002_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Haven't you heard the stories?
　A terror group wiped out in a single night,
　a small guerrilla band toppling a dictatorship.」

stage0002_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「$$ミスリル$$ was behind all of them.」

stage0002_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「They too are people of the 《$$ＡＤＷ$$》.
　They belong to no nation, but behind the Destruction
　Incident and the $$再世戦争$$, they intervened.」

stage0002_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$正太郎$$
「I had no idea.
　That there were organizations like that besides
　Celestial Being and Dancouga Nova...」

stage0002_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$マオ$$
「Our aims and principles are a little
　different from those two, though...」

stage0002_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$マオ$$
「But since what we did looked similar,
　$$ミスリル$$ used their activity as cover too.」

stage0002_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Though once they joined 《$$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$》, $$ミスリル$$'s
　activities naturally came into the open.」

stage0002_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$正太郎$$
「So they really were heroes of justice.」

stage0002_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$マオ$$
「It's nice to hear you say that,
　but it's nothing so grand.」

stage0002_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$マオ$$
「Those of us actually fighting in the field
　are mercenaries, each with our own reasons.」

stage0002_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Rumor has it their personnel are
　specialists in their respective fields.」

stage0002_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「And $$ミスリル$$'s overwhelming strength comes from
　fine equipment as well as fine personnel.」

stage0002_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「$$ミスリル$$ has its own development technology,
　and its gear is said to be ten years ahead of
　regular forces. The 《$$ＥＣＳ$$》 M9 you saw is one.」

stage0002_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$正太郎$$
「You mean that AS that vanished?」

stage0002_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$マオ$$
「That's right.
　We used that machine's $$ＥＣＳ$$ to stand guard
　over $$第２新東京市$$.」

stage0002_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$正太郎$$
「To think such an organization existed...
　But why didn't $$ＩＣＰＯ$$ or Director $$大塚$$
　tell me about it...」

stage0002_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Unlike Celestial Being, their activities
　were carried out entirely in secret.」

stage0002_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Some say they have deep ties to national militaries
　and the Earth Federation, so they were tolerated.」

stage0002_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$マオ$$
「Who knows...
　They don't tell me what goes on up top either.」

stage0002_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$マオ$$
「So $$ミスリル$$ running a joint operation with another
　organization through proper channels like this
　came as a total bolt from the blue to me.」

stage0002_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「$$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ is the same, the details of deals
　made at the top never reach the field.」

stage0002_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Still, it is a fact that we will now be working
　together. I look forward to it, Sergeant Major $$マオ$$.」

stage0002_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$マオ$$
「The three of us on the $$ＳＲＴ$$ team are seconded
　and will serve under $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ command.」

stage0002_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$マオ$$
「We're in your care from here on.
　...And yours too, $$正太郎$$.」

stage0002_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Official orders will likely come down to you
　from $$ＩＣＰＯ$$'s leadership within a few days.」

stage0002_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Our immediate operations are the investigation and
　destruction of terrorist groups based in Japan.」

stage0002_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$マオ$$
「Japan, Tokyo especially, is the economic heart
　of the newly established Earth Federation.」

stage0002_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$マオ$$
「And the ones looking to skim a profit off it
　are swarming in like insects.」

stage0002_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$正太郎$$
「I've heard about that too.
　Just like the robot mafia remnants in today's
　fight, criminals of every stripe are eyeing Tokyo.」

stage0002_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We will be operating to protect the peace and
　safety of the citizens from them.」

stage0002_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Won't the Earth Federation Forces move?
　If the other side is fielding robots,
　I'd think the military should handle it...」

stage0002_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...In fact, the ones who called for our
　cooperation this time were the Federation Forces.」

stage0002_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「It seems the newly reorganized Federation Forces
　still have a number of problems...」

stage0002_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「As a result they are often a step behind, and
　we were sounded out about filling that gap.」

stage0002_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$正太郎$$
「So that's why the response to yesterday's
　mystery enemy was so slow.」

stage0002_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「As for those Unknowns, I hear $$ミスリル$$ is
　running a detailed analysis of the wreckage.」

stage0002_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$マオ$$
「Captain $$ジェフリー$$,
　what's the situation with
　the other unknown machine?」

stage0002_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We're in the hangar calling on the pilot
　to come down out of the machine, but...」

stage0002_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$モニカ$$
「Captain, the pilot of that blue robot
　has answered our call.」

stage0002_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Understood.
　I'll head to the hangar myself.」

stage0002_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$マオ$$
「Well now... I'm looking forward to what comes out.」

stage0002_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$キャシー$$
「...The pilot says he'll open the hatch.
　All hands, confirm your positions.」

stage0002_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$クラン$$
「$$ミシェル$$, are you ready to shoot?」

stage0002_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「I'm good here.
　One wrong move and I'll put him down in one shot.」

stage0002_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$クルツ$$
「So how about a little contest,
　$$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ sniper boy?」

stage0002_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「I've been in this kind of contest before.」

stage0002_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Yeah, yeah...
　Now then, time for the thrilling introduction.」

stage0002_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$n
「$$相良宗介$$...
　Why are you here...」

stage0002_03:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$クルツ$$
「What is it, $$宗介$$?
　Someone you know?」

stage0002_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$宗介$$
「A student in Class 2-4 at Jindai High.」

stage0002_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$クルツ$$
「So a classmate at your infiltration post...」

stage0002_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$キャシー$$
「I am Lieutenant $$キャサリン・グラス$$.
　The captain has placed me in charge of handling you.」

stage0002_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$キャシー$$
「First, tell me your name and affiliation.」

stage0002_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$キャシー$$
「None...? Don't tell me you mean to claim
　this machine is your personal property?」

stage0002_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$宗介$$
「I'll say this first.
　We are not a regular army, so our handling of
　prisoners will not follow the Geneva Convention.」

stage0002_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$宗介$$
「To draw the information we need out of you,
　I don't intend to be choosy about methods.」

stage0002_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$クルツ$$
（At times like this, that stone face of his
　makes for a good bluff...）

stage0002_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$宗介$$
「Answer every one of our questions.
　That is the only way to protect yourself.」

stage0002_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$n
「Let me be clear.
　I don't intend to hand $$ジェニオン$$ over to anyone.」

stage0002_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$n
「If you won't be choosy about methods,
　then neither will I...!」

stage0002_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「This guy...!
　He means to resist!?」

stage0002_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$クルツ$$
（So that old man is $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$'s
　$$ジェフリー・ワイルダー$$...）

stage0002_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$宗介$$
（That presence...
　I see. He surpasses his reputation...）

stage0002_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「First, thank you for your cooperation.
　And for defending the city, yesterday and today.」

stage0002_03:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Since you answered our call,
　we have no intention of detaining you.」

stage0002_03:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「And of course, the same goes for that machine.
　We won't seize it against your will.」

stage0002_03:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「But as part of our duty, there are things
　we must confirm about you and your machine.
　I ask again for your cooperation.」

stage0002_03:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Then let me ask you.
　Is that machine your personal property?」

stage0002_03:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$アルト$$
「The captain says all that and you still
　mean to keep silent...!?」

stage0002_03:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
???
「IT IS NOT THAT HE WILL NOT ANSWER.
　$n CANNOT ANSWER.」

stage0002_03:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A PLEASURE TO MEET YOU.
　MY NAME IS $$ＡＧ$$.
　AN AGENT OF THE 《$$ＤＥＭ$$》 CORPORATION...」

stage0002_03:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$クラン$$
「How on earth did it get into the Quarter's hangar!?」

stage0002_03:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「THAT IS THAT...
　IT TAKES ONE TO KNOW ONE, AS THEY SAY...」

stage0002_03:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$n
「...What did you barge in here for?
　To irritate me?」

stage0002_03:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「DOES MY MANNER OF SPEAKING BOTHER YOU, PERHAPS?」

stage0002_03:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The way I spoke until now was simply
　giving priority to my identity as a robot.」

stage0002_03:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So, allow me to introduce myself again.
　I am $$ＡＧ$$... an agent of the $$ＤＥＭ$$ Corporation,
　and the handler of that $$ジェニオン$$.」

stage0002_03:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「$$ジェニオン$$...
　So that's the machine's name...」

stage0002_03:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes.
　$$ジェニオン$$ is a prototype of the $$ＤＥＭ$$ series,
　a new mobile weapon developed by our $$ＤＥＭ$$ Corporation.」

stage0002_03:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$ＤＥＭ$$ Corporation is short for
　Dimension Extra Merchant...」

stage0002_03:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「We do business across the parallel worlds
　of this multiverse.」

stage0002_03:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Well, I'm impressed...
　That's one outrageously enterprising fellow.」

stage0002_03:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$マオ$$
「I saw this machine appear along with the quake...」

stage0002_03:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes, exactly so.
　$$ＤＥＭ$$ was testing $$ジェニオン$$ in another dimension
　connected to this world, and...」

stage0002_03:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It was caught up in a quake that happened
　to occur, and fell into this world.」

stage0002_03:r_e5a692ea5ce09cac.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Furthermore, $n, who was there,
　also happened to be registered as its pilot,
　and here we are.」

stage0002_03:r_e793fc3ce3a0c28d.text:
$$正太郎$$
「So $$ジェニオン$$ coming to this world
　was an accident?」

stage0002_03:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes... most embarrassing.
　I ran the test, so I'll likely be written up for it.」

stage0002_03:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「What do you know about the robot
　that attacked $$第２新東京市$$?」

stage0002_03:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I have no data on that one.
　Most likely, just as with $$ジェニオン$$'s transfer,
　it was thrown into this world by chance.」

stage0002_03:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$クルツ$$
「I don't really follow, but your company
　can come and go between parallel worlds, right?」

stage0002_03:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$クルツ$$
「So if they'd just hurry up and collect it,
　wouldn't that settle everything?」

stage0002_03:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...This is doubly embarrassing, but the
　dimensional boundary of this world is very strong...」

stage0002_03:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$マオ$$
「In short, even with your technology
　you can't easily reach this world.」

stage0002_03:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Exactly!
　Ah, boss, it's a real help how quick you are!」

stage0002_03:r_c8b75f3bca245a85.text:
$$ルカ$$
「To build a robot like this...
　Between that and the dimensional travel tech,
　this $$ＤＥＭ$$'s technical ability is astonishing.」

stage0002_03:r_b26be73e3c0c8bed.text:
$$マオ$$
「Still, plenty about it bothers me...
　The defense system that $$ジェニオン$$ of yours used
　was the same in nature as the 《$$次元獣$$》.」

stage0002_03:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「When you say $$次元獣$$, you mean the
　dimensional weapons that ran rampant in this world.」

stage0002_03:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The D-Fault those also carried...
　the dimensional fault, as it's called, is a very
　common defense mechanism using $$次元力$$.」

stage0002_03:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$マオ$$
「So you claim no connection to the $$次元獣$$s?」

stage0002_03:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「True, both those and $$ジェニオン$$ are alike in being
　weapons that use 《$$次元力$$》, but
　our $$ＤＥＭ$$ achieves far more advanced control of it.」

stage0002_03:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The result is the TS-DEMON mounted in $$ジェニオン$$...
　Tactical System, Next-Gen $$次元力$$ Control.」

stage0002_03:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$ルカ$$
「DEMON, is it...
　In our world we call $$次元獣$$s DAMON...」

stage0002_03:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes, I am aware of that.
　My, how very similar they are.」

stage0002_03:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$クラン$$
（The whole thing reeks of something off...
　That machine, and this one too...）

stage0002_03:r_d41f1e36365baa6f.text:
$$マオ$$
（How am I supposed to trust a word from this thing...）

stage0002_03:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「For a robot like me to be given honorifics
　is unbearably ticklish.」

stage0002_03:r_d90c4affdd742a0e.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Amazing...!
　To be fitted with tactile sensors that fine...!」

stage0002_03:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$$キャシー$$
「Then, once more, $$ＡＧ$$...
　If his registration as $$ジェニオン$$'s pilot
　was truly an accident...」

stage0002_03:r_f5507082e5c31362.text:
$$キャシー$$
「Shouldn't that registration be undone at once?」

stage0002_03:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, you see... from a humanitarian view
　I did mean to do just that, but...」

stage0002_03:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$$アルト$$
「He accepted a thing this shady and a machine
　nobody can identify?」

stage0002_03:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Hey, hey...!
　You mean to play hero of justice
　in a robot that fell out of another dimension!?」

stage0002_03:r_c33c28fb471faf59.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Between us, for my own part I'd like to
　gather as much $$ジェニオン$$ data as possible
　before the recovery team arrives...」

stage0002_03:r_d0fc4899507f74b2.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So having $n
　willing to pilot $$ジェニオン$$
　is exactly what I could have wished for.」

stage0002_03:r_8a9ac301023aa8d3.text:
$$キャシー$$
「Captain, we have the outline on that $$ジェニオン$$.
　What will you do?」

stage0002_03:r_e4ae97a37c9b0cce.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「That is not mine to decide.
　It's his call. $F's.」

stage0002_03:r_38f89a2d27debb9e.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「From what $$ＡＧ$$ says,
　you are flying that $$ジェニオン$$
　under an agreement with him.」

stage0002_03:r_20aab898d4d14e51.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Then how you use it is surely
　no business of outsiders.」

stage0002_03:r_e418ba9e04898c28.text:
$$マオ$$
「If I may presume to offer an opinion, I agree.
　...Provided, of course, that his intent
　does not run counter to our objectives.」

stage0002_03:r_88461d9fd17c56e7.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Then, $F,
　let us hear your intent.」

stage0002_03:r_d7bf635b7e5f811c.text:
$n
「...Will you hire me aboard this ship?」

stage0002_03:r_3f9082480d045564.text:
$$アルト$$
「What are you saying, out of nowhere!?」

stage0002_03:r_312a78dfbb065f65.text:
$$クラン$$
「$$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ is not so short of people that we
　take in someone whose background is unknown...!」

stage0002_03:r_9f17991d2b19374c.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Please wait...!
　I think we can trust him!」

stage0002_03:r_67c9e002d64d9781.text:
$$正太郎$$
「When he first boarded $$ジェニオン$$, he was leading
　the enemy away so no one else would be caught up.」

stage0002_03:r_cb5e5d90104f7a88.text:
$$マオ$$
「Good eye, boy detective.
　...For the record, I agree with him.
　He's a bit defiant, but I feel like trusting him.」

stage0002_03:r_0a597f4cd9c8309b.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「What do you want from fighting alongside us?」

stage0002_03:r_833975ddd032dd18.text:
$n
「I want to become someone who can
　master that $$ジェニオン$$.」

stage0002_03:r_1de04d77f1060720.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Very well...
　Press you further and you'd hardly answer anyway.」

stage0002_03:r_bc2050dd9e12f5a4.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The terms of the contract come later, but
　from today I name you a special member of $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$」

stage0002_03:r_5149abbbcbee6ee4.text:
$$アルト$$
「This guy is one of us now...」

stage0002_03:r_bedf0f18c13c0a97.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not just $n, of course.
　As $$ジェニオン$$'s handler, naturally I too
　will join you, in the role of maintenance.」

stage0002_03:r_56d65b2dba1b5061.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah, I am a robot, so please don't
　concern yourselves with pay and the rest.」

stage0002_03:r_31865d3496c34d8b.text:
$n
「...You never do run out of things to say...」

stage0002_03:r_7d1683c9b3b3094a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, $n... now that your position
　is settled, I look forward to working with you.」

stage0002_03:r_3f3b91470236b2a8.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「You are also a classmate of Sergeant $$相良宗介$$.
　...Then for now we'll route contact through him.」

stage0002_03:r_9d80dc88f241858b.text:
$$マオ$$
「Alright, I'll drop you both off at $$第２新東京市$$.」

stage0002_03:r_23cb7be357e8a4e0.text:
$$クルツ$$
「So it's $n, right...?
　Look after $$宗介$$ at school for me.」

stage0002_03:r_f4f785c3e285cb39.text:
$$宗介$$
「You hold no rank, but I have seniority.」

stage0002_03:r_98c6e74747c3936c.text:
$$宗介$$
「...There's something I want to ask.」

stage0002_03:r_c0837a2b98000559.text:
$$宗介$$
「But your field skills are not an amateur's.
　What is that about?」

stage0002_03:r_0866340ed1139b99.text:
$n
「...My old man drilled it into me.」

stage0002_03:r_290faeefba2fe68d.text:
$$宗介$$
「That Jeet Kune Do as well?」

stage0002_03:r_65ef57e28bd90298.text:
$n
「My old man was a fanatic about that sort of thing.」

stage0002_03:r_03d92655c99f7c70.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Morning, $l, Sagara.
　You transfer students got friendly fast.」

stage0002_03:r_ae4d9169d6ff43a4.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Really?
　As class rep, I'd have been
　really happy if you had...」

stage0002_03:r_d9ad0726bf16dd92.text:
$n
「It's fine, Chidori.
　We're... yes, we're friends.」

stage0002_03:r_8cb00be7cca91c45.text:
$n
（Play along.
　Otherwise she'll keep hanging around us.）

stage0002_03:r_ce4ee5d4d2a4dc1d.text:
$$かなめ$$
「What's this, secrets between you two?」

stage0002_03:r_48a3f23147fd6b6d.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Mmm, that's kind of stiff...
　If you're friends, be more casual about it.」

stage0002_03:r_a38016b9c3d59e6e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Good!
　Now then, let's all walk in together!」

stage0002_03:r_9d00ee0ac3902eac.text:
$$宗介$$
（...Was this really the right call?）

stage0002_03:r_c545a5a303470d2c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The D-Trader is not yet unlocked
　in this scenario, so...」

stage0002_03:r_fb06b0a658b1ef40.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This D-Trader scenario will not be shown
　either, but the scenario is included
　to keep up appearances.」
